highlights: Ships actually explode now! Hull hits trigger explosions sized to the blow, up to a big one when your ship is destroyed.
Shields are now visible: a ring flashes around the ship whenever it absorbs a hit, shaped differently depending on the hull.
5 new HUD icons: shield, hull, energy, and cruise pilot next to their matching bars.
New on-screen notice when cruise pilot is active — previously had no visual feedback at all.
First real art pass on the menus: nebula background, angled-corner buttons, and a real gear icon on the options button.
Fixed: the login password field showed a plain white background instead of matching the rest of the dark theme.
Server performance improvements following the audit: mining and other internal processes use less CPU with many players at once.
More robustness against traffic spikes or connection surges — no visible in-game changes.
Fixed a real bug: your ship's facing direction wasn't always saved correctly when you logged out.
The server responds faster with lots of players connected at once.
Background stars no longer change size when you zoom.
With the camera zoomed way out, your own ship is now marked with a triangle pointing where you're headed.
The options button moved to the top-right corner.
Fixed a serious bug: the server could crash entirely (for everyone connected at that moment) right when you destroyed your own locked target with a shot.
The cruiser now turns and accelerates like an actual cruiser, not like the starting shuttle.
Real 360° movement with the joystick: a light touch just turns the ship, a real push accelerates it.
Cruise pilot: leave the ship traveling on its own at whatever speed it had, without keeping your finger on the screen.
With the camera zoomed out, ships and locked targets get a marker so you don't lose track of them.
If an enemy attacks you, it now gets auto-targeted back (can be turned off in options).
Removed the ionic turret variant with broken art from the catalog, and cleaned up a magenta halo that lingered on some turrets.
New turret family: thermal (plasma and laser) — all four damage families in the design are now represented.
32 real turrets integrated into the Ship Editor: kinetic, ionic, and radiological, ready to use.
Fine-tune position by coordinates, plus a recommended turret count per ship class.
New tool in the Ship Editor to place turret hardpoints on each ship, with automatic symmetry.
Tool to mark each turret's rotation pivot.
Fixed: the "Create account" button was nearly invisible, and the sign-in screen no longer flips language right in front of you.
Fixed: signing in with a remembered session could get you rejected with a bogus "character doesn't exist" error. Shouldn't happen anymore.
Fixed a bug that prevented playing after the combat patch. You can play normally again.
Combat begins: lock targets, fire, and test yourself against two enemy cruisers patrolling the system.
Your starting ship is now a cruiser, matching the game's first weapon.
Three new bars: shield, hull and energy. Flying well literally reduces the damage you take.
During testing there's no sign-in prompt: you go straight in and progress is still saved. Login stays ready to switch on when there are more players.
Signing in now uses email and password — no leaving the game to find an email.
Keep-me-signed-in checkbox: leave it ticked and it won't ask again.
Separate buttons for signing in and creating an account, with clear error messages.
Fixed: after signing in, the game didn't move on to pilot selection.
You can now sign in with your email: you get a link, no passwords needed.
Your pilots no longer live in the browser — they belong to your account and work from any device.
Progress is saved: when you come back, your ship is where you left it, with its cargo and hull.
Max 5 pilots per account and unique names, now enforced by the server.
New interface icons: 16 custom symbols (warp, mine, dock, jump point, asteroid, wreck, ruin…) packed into a single image that loads in one go.
The mine button becomes a single ACTION button that changes with whatever is in range: mine, dock, activate jump point or open a wreck.
A rotating reticle marks on screen which object the button will act on.
Asteroids now look like irregular rocks instead of grey circles.
Mining now depends on a module that takes up a slot and fits any ship — but dedicated mining ships will extract far more.
Sharpness fixed at the root: buttons and menus are now native browser UI instead of game rendering — they look perfect on any screen.
Second attempt at fixing sharpness — the previous change made it worse instead of better. Let us know if it looks right this time.
Fixed blurry text on buttons and the menu — now as sharp as everything else.
Your own name no longer shows above your ship (only other players').
New jet-style engine trail, longer the faster you go.
Fixed the ship flickering during warp.
Much sharper image on mobile and high-density screens — used to look blurry/grainy.
The map is now much bigger, at solar-system scale.
New warp system: charge the drive and rocket forward at 5x speed in a straight line. Green button next to the mining one (E key on PC).
You can zoom out much further now to see the map at a larger scale.
The options button is now a gear icon, bottom-right.
Fixed the engine trail, which was coming out of the ship's side instead of behind it.
Cleaner ship art for the full catalog — no visible change to the ship you're currently using.
Fixed reconnection — it used to always fail after minimizing the game on mobile, now it retries when you come back.
Fixed the menu and mining buttons drifting out of place when zooming out.
Fixed the ship jittering when zoomed in.
New blue plasma trail on the ship's engine.
New flight physics: your ship now has real inertia — it turns gradually and drifts a bit when turning sharply at high speed, instead of changing direction instantly.
Free movement in any direction, no longer just 8 fixed directions.
Fixed pinch-to-zoom — it wasn't working correctly on mobile before.
New patch notes screen on startup, highlighting what matters in each version.
Zoom with mouse wheel (PC) or pinch (mobile).
The game now supports multiple languages — pick yours from the options menu.
Text and window sizing adjustments so it looks good on any screen.
The Ship Codex is now an editor: change any ship's name, stats, sprite, or sound.
Changes can be exported and applied to the live game.
First real ships in the game, with engine sound.
New Ship Codex tool to browse the 41-ship catalog.
Much smoother movement with multiple players at once.
New character creation/selection screen (up to 5).
Ping indicator and automatic reconnect if the connection drops.
Visible border for the playable world.
Full touch controls: a joystick appears wherever you tap, plus a mining button.
Options menu with a button to close the game.
Fixed a bug that stopped ships from visibly moving.
First playable version: fly your ship, mine asteroids, and play with others in real time.
